public.title: Encode and Decode Strings
public.description: Implement operation "encode" on an array of strings or "decode" on a valid encoded string. Encode each string as its UTF-16 code-unit length in decimal, a colon, then its contents; concatenate the records. Decode reverses that exact format. Empty arrays encode as an empty string. At most 100 strings, each at most 100 UTF-16 code units, with at most 3000 UTF-16 code units in total across all string contents; decode inputs are valid encodings of arrays satisfying the same bounds. No escaping is used.
hints: Length prefixes make delimiters inside contents harmless.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Advance by the declared UTF-16 length rather than searching for the next delimiter in content. Encoding and decoding take time linear in the encoded size.
